title: After the Cesar Chavez Scandal, Can Johnny Itliong Restore His Father’s Activist Legacy?
summary: Johnny Itliong says Cesar Chavez stole credit from his father, the farmworker activist Larry Itliong. For years, he has been trying to correct the record.
